title: Design TUI interactive flow browser
description:
DESIGN (TUI interaction + architecture, agreed 2026-09-19; supersedes the original flow-browser sketch below, which remains the source of the navigation ideas).

Module layout: src/tui.rs, pure helpers separated from the imperative shell:
- tree_items(issues, epic_counts) -> Vec<TreeItem<String>>: epics (children part_of, newest first, with (done/total) progress) then orphaned pebbles; node ids are issue UUIDs.
- review_entries(issues) -> proposed issues, newest first.
- detail_lines(issue, related_titles, incoming) -> Vec<Line>: fields, relationships, incoming links, spec refs.
- App state: mode (Browser | Review | Help overlay), issues cache, TreeState<String>, review selection, transient message line. Data loads once at startup; mutations re-run Operations (approve/delete - each is its own jj commit) and reload the issue set.

Browser keys: j/k or Up/Down move (TreeState), Enter/f fold/unfold, ? help overlay, r review mode, q quit. Review keys: a approve, d close (delete, y confirms), j/k move, Esc/r back, q quit. Left pane 40% tree, right 60% detail.

CLI entry: `pebbles tui` (Commands::Tui). Errors (not initialized) print and exit non-zero; no TTY-specific trycmd coverage.

Testing layers (per ea0/d5b evaluations): unit tests on the pure helpers; TestBackend snapshot tests for rendering; termlens e2e for a small set of flows (initial render, navigation, approve round-trip, quit/alt-screen restoration) using PEBBLES_DB_PATH + .no_jj fixtures. trycmd stays CLI-only.

SPEC: add r[tui], r[tui-review] when this lands (issue 639). Multi-project layer and edit pane are later children (c30, cb0).
